html:
Given words, group words having identical case-sensitive character counts. Preserve input order inside each group and order groups by their first encountered word.

Call solve with the positional arguments shown in each test. Return the result; do not print.

Example

{
  "args": [
    [
      "arc",
      "cat",
      "car",
      "act",
      "dog"
    ]
  ],
  "expected": [
    [
      "arc",
      "car"
    ],
    [
      "cat",
      "act"
    ],
    [
      "dog"
    ]
  ]
}

Example

{
  "args": [
    []
  ],
  "expected": []
}
Hint

Use a canonical character order as a grouping key.

Complexity: O(sum(L log L)) time and O(total characters) space

489 explicit tests pass across the 160 original exercises
